Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 40
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made the critical error at Step 40 by asserting that "Modern Martial Arts Tribeca" is within a five-minute walk of the New York Stock Exchange (11 Wall St) and offering classes from 7-9 pm. This claim was based on the failure of the WebSurfer agent to successfully navigate the website to verify the specific location of the "Tribeca" branch (which is in the Financial District at 78 Reade St, roughly 0.5 miles from the NYSE) or its specific class schedule. Instead of recognizing that the available information did not confirm the location was within the 5-minute walk constraint or that the class times were available during the requested window, the Orchestrator hallucinated a positive result and terminated the conversation with a factually incorrect answer.
